sources.title: Multilayer perceptron - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Mathematical foundations Activation function If a multilayer perceptron has a linear activation function in all neurons, that is, a linear function that maps the weighted inputs to the output of each neuron, then linear algebra shows that any number of layers can be reduced to a two-layer input-output model.
